facts.fact: Comores Infos reports that the startup Komor-IA, founded in August 2025 by Soilahoudine Mohamed Ali, is developing three AI projects: Press-IA, Agro-IA (plant disease detection) and Health-IA (a breast-cancer diagnosis prototype claimed at 85% precision).

Komor-IA published KomoriTTS, a beta text-to-speech model for Shikomori (Shingazidja dialect) trained on its community voice corpus, and Al-watwan wrote about it on 4 August 2026, per Komor-IA's LinkedIn post.

facts.fact: Komor-IA, a Comorian AI initiative, released version 1.0 of the French-shiKomori Parallel Dataset on Hugging Face, with 1,424 French-Shingazidja sentence pairs contributed by Comorian volunteers, under gated access.

An arXiv preprint of 2024-12-09 reports Comorian datasets mixed with Swahili used to train a machine translation model (ROUGE-1 0.6826) and an ASR system (WER 39.50%), without stating a release of the models or data.
